sites.source: https://wvdnr.gov/lands-waters/wildlife-management-areas/district-1-wildlife-management-areas/ ('17. Pleasant Creek ... On the WMA: campsites – 40 tent/trailer open seasonally'), read 2026-10-21

note: Two small WV DNR campgrounds in Pleasant Creek Wildlife Management Area, on the ridge south of Doe Run Lake and next to Tygart Lake State Park (Taylor/Barbour counties). Shooting range on the WMA. --Claude
summary: WV DNR District 1 page confirms 40 tent/trailer campsites open seasonally and vault toilets (sites/facilities now manual; season year_round false, no dates); the DNR map labels the campgrounds. Not stated: fees, reservations, rig size, hookups or water (derived electric 0 / potable_water false left). Owned by WVDNR and USACE, managed by DNR Wildlife Resources, so ownership state stands. Note trimmed of the site count, season, toilets and hookups/water restatements.
flags: Criteria: DNR says only 'tent/trailer' campsites; no page gives a site length or says a 23-ft motorhome fits. No fee or booking information on any DNR page.

Where camping is allowed (for asks #8): the District 1 page lists 'campsites – 40 tent/trailer open seasonally' on the WMA and nothing more; no WV rule about distance from water or facilities appears on the page.
